operations.purpose: Acquire through a later getter-only host adapter and replay a portable immutable model, mapping, selection, and force snapshot without moving engineering calculations into ETABS or Excel.

required_inputs.name: source expectation and explicit optional evidence states
member, station, result-selection, and result-kind scope
raw capture and completed getter call ledger
model facts, units, axes, mappings, selections, stations, and same-row actions

outputs.name: independent result states, diagnostics, provenance, and limitations

optional_inputs.name: process_identity
optional_inputs.rule: portable optional evidence: supplied value or named not_requested/unavailable/not_applicable reason

optional_inputs.name: model_file_sha256
optional_inputs.rule: portable optional evidence: supplied lowercase SHA-256 or named non-supplied reason

optional_inputs.name: member/station filters
optional_inputs.rule: explicit tagged selection mode; empty arrays mean all only under all_beams/all_available

optional_inputs.name: step_number
optional_inputs.rule: required JSON key; null for non-step actions and numeric for staged_step/response_result

provenance: row disposition, exclusion approval, limitations, and evidence-manifest digest
